get_user.description: Read properties and relationships of a user object.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to return instead of the default set (businessPhones, displayName, givenName, id, jobTitle, mail, mobilePhone, officeLocation, preferredLanguage, surname, userPrincipalName).

list_users.description: Gets a list of user objects in the directory, returning a default property set per user unless $select specifies others.

params.name: $count
params.description: Include a count of matching users (requires the ConsistencyLevel: eventual header together with $search or certain $filter expressions).

params.name: $expand
params.description: Expand related entities inline (OData $expand).

params.name: $filter
params.description: Filter the user collection (OData $filter); advanced filter expressions require the ConsistencyLevel: eventual header.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Order the results by a property (OData $orderby).

params.name: $search
params.description: Search users (OData $search); requires the ConsistencyLevel: eventual header.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to return instead of the default set.

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of users to return per page (default 100, max 999; max 500 if $select or $filter is used on signInActivity).

create_user.description: Creates a new user object, returning the created user record.

params.name: accountEnabled
params.description: Whether the account is enabled.

params.name: displayName
params.description: The name displayed in the address book.

params.name: mailNickname
params.description: The mail alias for the user.

params.name: userPrincipalName
params.description: The user's principal name (UPN), usually their sign-in email.

params.name: passwordProfile
params.description: Initial password settings: forceChangePasswordNextSignIn (bool) and password (string).

params.name: onPremisesImmutableId
params.description: Associates an on-prem AD account with the Entra user object; required only when userPrincipalName uses a federated domain.

update_user.endpoint: PATCH /me (or PATCH /users/{user_id} when user_id is given)
update_user.description: Updates properties on the signed-in user's own profile, or on another user's profile when user_id is given (requires higher-privileged admin permissions); supply only the properties to change.

params.name: user_id
params.description: id (GUID) or userPrincipalName of another user to update instead of the signed-in user. Requires higher-privileged permissions than updating /me. Omit to update your own profile.

params.name: aboutMe
params.description: Freeform self-description. Must be updated alone in its own request; not updatable with application-only permissions.

params.name: accountEnabled
params.description: true if the account is enabled. Requires User.EnableDisableAccount.All + User.Read.All (least privileged).

params.name: ageGroup
params.description: null, Minor, NotAdult, or Adult.

params.name: birthday
params.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Must be updated alone; not updatable with application-only permissions.

params.name: businessPhones
params.description: Only one number can actually be set, despite being a collection.

params.name: city
params.description: The user's city.

params.name: companyName
params.description: Max 64 characters.

params.name: consentProvidedForMinor
params.description: null, Granted, Denied, or NotRequired.

params.name: country
params.description: e.g. US, UK.

params.name: customSecurityAttributes
params.description: Requires the Attribute Assignment Administrator role + CustomSecAttributeAssignment.ReadWrite.All.

params.name: department
params.description: Department name.

params.name: displayName
params.description: Required at creation; can't be cleared on update.

params.name: employeeHireDate
params.description: ISO 8601 UTC.

params.name: employeeId
params.description: Max 16 characters.

params.name: employeeLeaveDateTime
params.description: Requires the Global Administrator role (delegated) + User-LifeCycleInfo.ReadWrite.All and User.Read.All.

params.name: employeeOrgData
params.description: Include both division and costCenter — any you omit are set to null.

params.name: employeeType
params.description: e.g. Employee, Contractor, Consultant, Vendor.

params.name: givenName
params.description: First name.

params.name: identities
params.description: Replaces the entire collection; must include the userPrincipalName signInType identity. Requires User.ManageIdentities.All.

params.name: interests
params.description: Must be updated alone; not updatable with application-only permissions.

params.name: jobTitle
params.description: Job title.

params.name: mail
params.description: SMTP address; also updates proxyAddresses. Can't be set to null.

params.name: mailNickname
params.description: Mail alias.

params.name: mobilePhone
params.description: Primary cell number. Requires User-Phone.ReadWrite.All (least privileged).

params.name: mySite
params.description: URL of personal site. Must be updated alone; not updatable with application-only permissions.

params.name: officeLocation
params.description: Office location.

params.name: onPremisesExtensionAttributes
params.description: extensionAttributes 1-15; read-only when synced from on-premises.

params.name: onPremisesImmutableId
params.description: Associates an on-prem AD account with the Entra user object; $ and _ aren't allowed.

params.name: otherMails
params.description: Pass the full set you want — existing values are overwritten, not merged. Max 250 values, 250 chars each. Requires User-Mail.ReadWrite.All (least privileged).

params.name: passwordPolicies
params.description: e.g. DisableStrongPassword, DisablePasswordExpiration (can combine).

params.name: passwordProfile
params.description: Resets the user's password; set forceChangePasswordNextSignIn to true as best practice. Not usable for federated users. Requires User-PasswordProfile.ReadWrite.All (least privileged).

params.name: pastProjects
params.description: Must be updated alone; not updatable with application-only permissions.

params.name: postalCode
params.description: Postal/ZIP code.

params.name: preferredLanguage
params.description: ISO 639-1 code, e.g. en-US.

params.name: responsibilities
params.description: Must be updated alone; not updatable with application-only permissions.

params.name: schools
params.description: Must be updated alone; not updatable with application-only permissions.

params.name: skills
params.description: Must be updated alone; not updatable with application-only permissions.

params.name: state
params.description: State/province.

params.name: streetAddress
params.description: Street address.

params.name: surname
params.description: Last name.

params.name: usageLocation
params.description: Two-letter ISO 3166 country code; required before license assignment.

params.name: userPrincipalName
params.description: UPN / sign-in name. Only A-Z a-z 0-9 ' . - _ ! # ^ ~ allowed, no accent characters.

params.name: userType
params.description: e.g. Member, Guest.

delete_user.description: Deletes a user object by id or userPrincipalName; the user's resources remain recoverable for 30 days before permanent deletion.

params.name: id
params.description: The id (GUID) or userPrincipalName of the user to delete.

get_users_delta.description: Gets incremental changes to user objects since the last delta query, returning changed users plus a paging or delta link.

params.name: $deltatoken
params.description: State token from the previous @odata.deltaLink; pass the full deltaLink URL to start the next round of change tracking.

params.name: $skiptoken
params.description: State token from the previous @odata.nextLink, indicating more changes remain in the current round.

params.name: $select
params.description: Properties to return; only takes effect on the initial delta request of a tracking round.

params.name: $filter
params.description: Only $filter=id eq '{value}' is supported (combine with or for up to 50 ids).

params.name: return_minimal
params.description: When true, sends the Prefer: return=minimal header so a request using @odata.deltaLink returns only properties that changed since that link was issued.

create_draft_message.description: Create a draft of a new message, saved to the Drafts folder by default.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject line of the message.

params.name: importance
params.description: Importance of the message: Low, Normal, or High.

params.name: body
params.description: Message body, with contentType (Text or HTML) and content.

params.name: toRecipients
params.description: Recipients of the message, each as {emailAddress: {address}}.

params.name: internetMessageHeaders
params.description: Custom Internet message headers, each as {name, value}.

create_draft_to_forward_message.description: Create a draft of the Forward message for an existing message; the draft can then be updated or sent.

params.name: id
params.description: Path parameter — ID of the message to forward.

params.name: toRecipients
params.description: Top-level recipients list. Specify either this or message.toRecipients, not both.

params.name: message
params.description: Message properties to pre-set on the draft (e.g. toRecipients). Specify either message.toRecipients or the top-level toRecipients, not both; either message.body or comment, not both.

params.name: comment
params.description: Comment prepended to the forwarded message. Mutually exclusive with message.body.

create_draft_to_reply_all.description: Create a draft of the Reply All message for an existing message; the draft can then be updated or sent.

params.name: id
params.description: Path parameter — ID of the message being replied to.

params.name: comment
params.description: Plain-text comment prepended to the reply; can be an empty string. Mutually exclusive with message.body.

params.name: message
params.description: Message properties to pre-set on the draft. Specify either this (message.body) or comment, not both.

create_draft_to_reply.description: Create a draft of the Reply message for an existing message; the draft can then be updated or sent.

params.name: id
params.description: Path parameter — ID of the message being replied to.

params.name: comment
params.description: Plain-text comment prepended to the reply; can be an empty string. Mutually exclusive with message.body.

params.name: message
params.description: Message properties to pre-set on the draft, e.g. toRecipients to add recipients beyond the original sender. Specify either this (message.body) or comment, not both.

forward_message.description: Forward a message in a single call; the forward is saved in the Sent Items folder.

params.name: id
params.description: Path parameter — ID of the message to forward.

params.name: toRecipients
params.description: Recipients to forward to, each as {emailAddress: {name, address}}.

params.name: comment
params.description: Optional comment prepended to the forwarded message; can be an empty string.

get_message.description: Read the properties and relationships of a message object.

params.name: id
params.description: Path parameter — unique identifier of the message.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to return instead of the full message object.

list_messages.description: Get all the messages in the signed-in user's mailbox, including the Deleted Items and Clutter folders.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to return.

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression to restrict the messages returned.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Property to sort the results by.

params.name: $search
params.description: Search expression.

params.name: $top
params.description: Page size, 1-1000, default 10.

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of results to skip. Prefer following @odata.nextLink for paging instead of setting this manually.

reply_all_message.description: Reply to all recipients of a message in a single call; the reply is saved in the Sent Items folder.

params.name: id
params.description: Path parameter — ID of the message being replied to.

params.name: comment
params.description: Optional plain-text comment prepended to the reply; can be an empty string. No message override parameter is documented for this endpoint.

reply_message.description: Reply to the sender of a message in a single call; the reply is saved in the Sent Items folder.

params.name: id
params.description: Path parameter — ID of the message being replied to.

params.name: comment
params.description: Optional plain-text comment prepended to the reply; can be an empty string.

params.name: message
params.description: Message properties to override, e.g. adding extra toRecipients beyond the original sender.

send_draft_message.description: Send a previously created message draft; the message is then saved in the Sent Items folder.

params.name: id
params.description: Path parameter — ID of the draft to send, from create_draft_message, create_draft_to_reply, create_draft_to_reply_all, or create_draft_to_forward_message.

send_mail.description: Send the message specified in the request body, composing and sending in a single call without first creating a draft.

params.name: message
params.description: Full message resource to send, e.g. subject, body, toRecipients, ccRecipients, attachments.

params.name: saveToSentItems
params.description: Whether to save the sent message to Sent Items. Defaults to true.

update_message.description: Applies a partial update to a message's fields and returns the updated message with the new values applied.

params.name: id
params.description: The message to update (from list_messages or get_message).

params.name: bccRecipients
params.description: The Bcc recipients for the message. Updatable only if isDraft is true.

params.name: body
params.description: The body of the message (contentType and content). Updatable only if isDraft is true.

params.name: categories
params.description: The categories associated with the message.

params.name: ccRecipients
params.description: The Cc recipients for the message. Updatable only if isDraft is true.

params.name: flag
params.description: Status, start date, due date, or completion date for the message (followupFlag).

params.name: from_
params.description: The mailbox owner and sender, sent to the API as `from`; must correspond to the actual mailbox used.

params.name: importance
params.description: Low, Normal, or High.

params.name: inferenceClassification
params.description: focused or other.

params.name: internetMessageId
params.description: The message ID per RFC2822. Updatable only if isDraft is true.

params.name: isDeliveryReceiptRequested
params.description: Whether a delivery receipt is requested for the message.

params.name: isRead
params.description: Whether the message has been read.

params.name: isReadReceiptRequested
params.description: Whether a read receipt is requested for the message.

params.name: multiValueExtendedProperties
params.description: Nullable collection of multi-value extended properties. Updatable only if isDraft is true.

params.name: replyTo
params.description: The email addresses to use when replying. Updatable only if isDraft is true.

params.name: sender
params.description: The account actually used to generate the message; must correspond to the actual mailbox used.

params.name: singleValueExtendedProperties
params.description: Nullable collection of single-value extended properties. Updatable only if isDraft is true.

params.name: subject
params.description: The subject of the message. Updatable only if isDraft is true.

params.name: toRecipients
params.description: The To recipients for the message. Updatable only if isDraft is true.

delete_message.description: Deletes a message by moving it to Deleted Items (a soft, recoverable delete) and returns no content.

params.name: id
params.description: The message to delete (from list_messages or get_message).

copy_message.description: Copies a message to a destination folder, leaving the original in place, and returns the new copy with its own id.

params.name: id
params.description: The message to copy (from list_messages or get_message).

params.name: destinationId
params.description: The destination folder's ID, or a well-known folder name.

get_message_delta.description: Gets messages added, updated, or deleted in a mail folder since the last sync, returning a page of changes plus a link to continue or complete the sync round.

params.name: id
params.description: The mail folder to track changes in (a folder ID, or a well-known folder name such as inbox).

params.name: $deltatoken
params.description: A state token from the previous delta call's @odata.deltaLink, to start the next round of change tracking.

params.name: $skiptoken
params.description: A state token from the previous delta call's @odata.nextLink, to continue the current round of change tracking.

params.name: changeType
params.description: Filter the delta response by change type: created, updated, or deleted. Must be specified on the initial delta call.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return; the id property is always returned. Must be specified on the initial delta call.

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Must be specified on the initial delta call.

params.name: $expand
params.description: Related resources to expand inline. Must be specified on the initial delta call.

params.name: $filter
params.description: Limited support: only receivedDateTime ge {value} or receivedDateTime gt {value}. Must be specified on the initial delta call.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Limited support: only receivedDateTime desc; otherwise return order isn't guaranteed. Must be specified on the initial delta call.

params.name: max_page_size
params.description: Sent as the Prefer: odata.maxpagesize={value} header, capping how many messages are returned per page.

move_message.description: Moves a message to a destination folder by creating a new copy there and removing the original, returning the moved message with its new id.

params.name: id
params.description: The message to move (from list_messages or get_message).

params.name: destinationId
params.description: The destination folder's ID, or a well-known folder name (e.g. deleteditems).

permanently_delete_message.description: Permanently deletes a message into the mailbox's purges folder, bypassing Deleted Items, and returns no content.

params.name: user_id
params.description: The mailbox owner's user ID or user principal name (first {id} in the path).

params.name: id
params.description: The message to permanently delete (from list_messages or get_message; second {id} in the path).

list_calendars.description: Lists all the signed-in user's calendars, or the calendars in a specific calendar group.

params.name: select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to return.

params.name: calendar_group_id
params.description: ID of a calendar group to list calendars from instead of all of the user's calendars.

get_calendar.description: Gets the properties of the signed-in user's default calendar, or a specific one of their other calendars.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of a specific calendar to get. Omit to get the default calendar.

params.name: select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to return.

list_events.description: Lists single-instance meetings and series masters in the signed-in user's mailbox.

params.name: select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to return.

params.name: filter
params.description: OData filter expression. Can't be used on the recurrence property.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Property to sort the results by.

params.name: top
params.description: Maximum number of events to return per page.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of results to skip.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Time zone name sent as the Prefer: outlook.timezone header.

params.name: body_content_type
params.description: Set to 'text' to receive the event body as plain text.

create_event.description: Creates a new event on the signed-in user's default calendar.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject line of the event.

params.name: start
params.description: Start time as {dateTime, timeZone}.

params.name: end
params.description: End time as {dateTime, timeZone}.

params.name: body
params.description: Event body as {contentType, content}.

params.name: location
params.description: Location as {displayName, ...}.

params.name: attendees
params.description: Attendees, each as {emailAddress, type}.

params.name: allowNewTimeProposals
params.description: Whether invitees may propose a new time.

params.name: transactionId
params.description: Client-generated ID for tracking/idempotency.

params.name: isOnlineMeeting
params.description: Whether to make this an online meeting.

params.name: onlineMeetingProvider
params.description: Online meeting provider, e.g. teamsForBusiness.

params.name: recurrence
params.description: Recurrence pattern as {pattern, range}.

params.name: sensitivity
params.description: normal, personal, private, or confidential.

params.name: showAs
params.description: free, tentative, busy, oof, workingElsewhere, or unknown.

params.name: reminderMinutesBeforeStart
params.description: Minutes before start to show a reminder.

params.name: isReminderOn
params.description: Whether a reminder is set.

params.name: categories
params.description: Category names to assign.

params.name: hideAttendees
params.description: When true, only the organizer can see attendees.

params.name: responseRequested
params.description: Whether invitees are asked to respond.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Time zone sent as the Prefer: outlook.timezone header.

get_event.description: Retrieves the full properties of a single event by its id.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the event.

params.name: select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to return.

params.name: expand
params.description: Related resources to expand inline.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Time zone sent as the Prefer: outlook.timezone header.

params.name: body_content_type
params.description: Set to 'text' to receive the event body as plain text.

update_event.description: Updates fields on an existing event; returns both the before and after state.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the event to update.

params.name: subject
params.description: Subject line of the event.

params.name: body
params.description: Event body as {contentType, content}.

params.name: start
params.description: Start time as {dateTime, timeZone}.

params.name: end
params.description: End time as {dateTime, timeZone}.

params.name: location
params.description: Location as {displayName, ...}.

params.name: locations
params.description: Multiple locations.

params.name: attendees
params.description: Attendees, each as {emailAddress, type}.

params.name: categories
params.description: Category names.

params.name: hideAttendees
params.description: When true, only the organizer can see attendees.

params.name: importance
params.description: low, normal, or high.

params.name: isAllDay
params.description: Whether the event lasts all day.

params.name: isOnlineMeeting
params.description: Whether this is an online meeting.

params.name: isReminderOn
params.description: Whether a reminder is set.

params.name: onlineMeetingProvider
params.description: Online meeting provider.

params.name: recurrence
params.description: Recurrence pattern as {pattern, range}.

params.name: reminderMinutesBeforeStart
params.description: Minutes before start to show a reminder.

params.name: responseRequested
params.description: Whether invitees are asked to respond.

params.name: sensitivity
params.description: normal, personal, private, or confidential.

params.name: showAs
params.description: free, tentative, busy, oof, workingElsewhere, or unknown.

delete_event.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Deletes an event by moving it to Deleted Items.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the event to delete.

cancel_event.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Sends a cancellation message from the organizer to all attendees and cancels the meeting.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the event to cancel.

params.name: comment
params.description: Message to send to attendees explaining the cancellation.

accept_event.description: Accepts an event invitation on the signed-in user's calendar.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the event to accept.

params.name: comment
params.description: Message to send with the response.

params.name: sendResponse
params.description: Whether to send a response to the organizer.

tentatively_accept_event.description: Tentatively accepts an event invitation on the signed-in user's calendar, optionally proposing a new time.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the event to tentatively accept.

params.name: comment
params.description: Message to send with the response.

params.name: sendResponse
params.description: Whether to send a response to the organizer.

params.name: proposedNewTime
params.description: A new time to propose, as {start, end}.

decline_event.description: Declines an event invitation on the signed-in user's calendar, optionally proposing a new time.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the event to decline.

params.name: comment
params.description: Message to send with the response.

params.name: sendResponse
params.description: Whether to send a response to the organizer.

params.name: proposedNewTime
params.description: A new time to propose, as {start, end}.

find_meeting_times.description: Finds candidate meeting times based on attendee availability, location, and time constraints.

params.name: attendees
params.description: Attendees to check availability for.

params.name: isOrganizerOptional
params.description: Whether the organizer's availability can be ignored.

params.name: locationConstraint
params.description: Location requirements.

params.name: maxCandidates
params.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return.

params.name: meetingDuration
params.description: Meeting duration as an ISO 8601 duration.

params.name: minimumAttendeePercentage
params.description: Minimum percentage of attendees that must be available.

params.name: returnSuggestionReasons
params.description: Whether to include a suggestionReason on each result.

params.name: timeConstraint
params.description: Time window(s) to search within.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Time zone sent as the Prefer: outlook.timezone header.

get_free_busy_schedule.description: Gets free/busy availability for a set of users, distribution lists, or resources over a specified time period.

params.name: schedules
params.description: Email addresses of the users, distribution lists, or resources to check.

params.name: startTime
params.description: Start of the period as {dateTime, timeZone}.

params.name: endTime
params.description: End of the period as {dateTime, timeZone}.

params.name: availabilityViewInterval
params.description: Duration in minutes of each slot in the returned availabilityView.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Time zone sent as the Prefer: outlook.timezone header.

list_calendar_view.description: Gets events for a date range, expanding recurring series into individual occurrence instances.

params.name: startDateTime
params.description: Start of the time range, ISO 8601.

params.name: endDateTime
params.description: End of the time range, ISO 8601.

params.name: select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to return.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Time zone sent as the Prefer: outlook.timezone header.

params.name: body_content_type
params.description: Set to 'text' to receive the event body as plain text.
